newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRA-Australia Oct skilled vacancies fall 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRA-Australia Oct skilled vacancies fall 1.4 pct.

text.p: The Australian government's index of skilled job vacancies fell 1.4 percent in October, the Employment Department said on Thursday.
The index fell to 137, the tenth consecutive monthly fall and 18.9 percent below the index for the same month in 1995, the department said in a statement.
Falls were recorded for 10 of the 16 occupational groups, while five increased and one remained unchanged.
The biggest falls were 5.6 percent in the business professionals sector and 5.3 percent in health diagnosis and treatment.
Wood trades increased 4.5 percent and registered nurses increased 3.1 percent, the department said.
The index was 107.6 percent above the recession low of 66 recorded in mid-1991.
The index measures skilled vacancy advertisements in the major city newspapers on the first Saturday of each month.
